limitations: Same-tab file replacements reuse note containers and do not reliably restart a CSS animation.
No outgoing crossfade or animation on focus of an already-visible split/stacked pane.
Input probes update editable DOM and dispatch an input event; not native CodeMirror or IME acceptance.
System Reduce Motion and print media were checked by source policy tests, not by changing system settings or exporting PDF this round.
Phone fixture keeps its test module tabs visible; it does not prove native iOS exposes desktop tab controls.
